events.name: Bacchanal Road 2027
events.venue: port of spain, Trinidad and Tobago
events.description: Bacchanal Road is more than a party—it's an unforgettable Carnival road experience where thousands of revelers come together to celebrate freedom, music, and pure Caribbean vibes. Follow the music truck as the road transforms into a sea of color, with paint, powder, water, mud, and non-stop soca creating the ultimate fête atmosphere. From the first beat to the final wine, expect premium vibes, energetic DJs, live performances, immersive entertainment, and an electric crowd that knows how to party.
